text: At the third Cooling Pledge Ministerial in Antalya on 16 November, co-chaired by Singapore and UNEP, governments backed a country-led, voluntary roadmap on heat resilience and sustainable cooling.

where: Signal: third Cooling Pledge Ministerial (next step)
text: The roadmap is to be launched at COP32 in Addis Ababa.

where: Signal: third Cooling Pledge Ministerial (funding, announced)
text: More than US$20 million in new support was announced for the Cool Coalition's work on the Global Cooling Pledge.
